description:
The FavoriteBikes Hybrid is a Class 3 commuter e-bike built around a 500W Bafang rear-hub motor with cadence sensing. Pedal assist reaches up to 28 mph and the throttle up to 20 mph where local laws permit. A removable 48V 10.4Ah battery, Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, and Tektro mechanical disc brakes support everyday rides, while 27.5×2.2 tires suit mixed pavement.
Integrated lights, app connectivity, a rear rack, and fenders round out a practical commuter package. Estimated range is up to 40 miles; actual range varies with rider weight, terrain, assist level, tire pressure, and riding conditions.
Favorite Smart System color display integrated into the handlebar. 01. Favorite color display. The built-in LG color LCD keeps speed, battery, assist level, and essential ride information clearly in view.
FavoriteBikes integrated Smart Headlight beneath the handlebar. 02. 1,600-lumen Smart Headlight. A dusk-to-dawn sensor, independent high beam, and handlebar-integrated design help keep the road ahead visible as conditions change.
Frame-integrated Favorite Smart System hardware above the rear wheel. 03. Integrated Smart System hardware. Protected electronics are built into the frame, keeping the connected system tidy, centralized, and part of the bike rather than an add-on.
FavoriteBikes mobile app screens showing navigation and ride information. 04. FavoriteBikes app. Connect through Bluetooth on iOS or Android for navigation, ride data, supported settings, and over-the-air firmware updates.
Hybrid rear wheel with 500W Bafang hub motor. 05. 500W Bafang sine-wave motor. Smooth, quiet rear-hub assist is calibrated for daily commuting, steady starts, and moderate hills.
Hybrid switchable-mode cadence sensor component. 06. Switchable cadence sensor. Commuting and off-road assist modes let you choose a smoother everyday response or stronger support when the route demands it.
Hybrid GTMRK hydraulic suspension fork. 07. GTMRK hydraulic suspension fork. Front suspension helps absorb broken pavement and uneven paths for more control and everyday comfort.
Hybrid Tektro MD-M280 mechanical disc brake. 08. Tektro mechanical disc brakes. MD-M280 brakes deliver dependable wet-and-dry stopping with an electric motor cut-off sensor.
Hybrid Shimano Altus 7-speed derailleur and shifter. 09. 7-speed Shimano Altus. An RD-M310-L derailleur and 7-speed shifter provide light, reliable changes for hills, flats, and stop-and-go riding.
